purpose: Original concept reference only; production pixels authored separately

prompts.name: dust_zinc
prompts.prompt: Create one original item sprite concept for a zinc ore-processing game addon. No source images are supplied: invent the silhouette and pixel layout from scratch, never reproduce an existing game/mod icon. Asset type: a tiny 16x16 logical-pixel inventory icon, shown enlarged as exactly square crisp pixel blocks for review. Transparent background with real alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no labels, no text, no frame, no shadow outside the sprite. One centered sprite, generous one-pixel padding. Strict pixel art: about 16 by 16 logical pixels, hard edges, no antialiasing, no painterly detail, no smooth gradient, no glow. Limited consistent palette: deepest desaturated green-charcoal outlines, mid gray sage/silver metal, pale mint-silver highlights. Light comes from upper left. Icon must read clearly when tiny. A compact low mound of refined zinc powder: fine granular silver-sage pile, broad triangular silhouette, scalloped lower edge, two loose grains at the sides, upper-left light speckles. This is clean powder, not a nugget or scattered confetti. Three-toned shading, subtle dark lower outline.
